title: Feature-Path Retrieval View
description: Tranche-one retrieval-view contract for Lux feature-path retrieval. Returns a compact evidence packet for a route- or handler-centered feature question by combining structural surface, handler, contract, ownership, bounded operational, and trust-aware cross-language evidence. Direct evidence and context are kept separate; this is not a final reasoning surface.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped on any breaking change to this contract.

question.description: Original natural-language question as provided by the operator.

overlayTrustLevel.description: Operator-facing overlay trust level (e.g. overlay-complete, degraded-overlay, content-only). Carried verbatim from the existing overlay-trust-state derivation.

target.description: Resolved feature-path target. Null when resolution did not produce a concrete target.

ownership.description: Domain ownership. Null when no plausible region can be attributed to the target.

contracts.description: Structurally recoverable request, response, and downstream payload contracts. Null when no contract was recovered.

directEvidence.description: Material that directly supports the compact retrieval summary. Adjacent or contextual signal must NOT appear here.

context.description: Adjacent but non-proving information. Must remain visibly separate from directEvidence.

downstreamStep.description: At most ONE bounded operational hop where it materially completes the answer. Null when no justified downstream step exists.

crossLanguage.description: Cross-language (e.g. backend-to-frontend) participation. Includes explicit refusal modes when the trust threshold is not met.

failures.description: Failure classifications attached to this retrieval view. Empty when the view is fully proven. Non-empty failures do not preclude a partial evidence packet.

trustTier.description: Lux trust tier 1..5 (higher = stronger evidence). Mirrors existing OperationalBoundary / StructuralEdge trust grading.

confidence.description: Confidence band for the compact retrieval summary. Mirrors operational ask confidence grading.

resolutionMatchType.description: How the question target was matched to a persisted feature-path target. semantic-exact means equality after normalization (case, framework prefixes, route shape).

featurePathIntent.description: First locked set of feature-path intents. Tranche one stays narrow on route- and handler-centered retrieval questions. route-callers reports persisted consumers/context, not an exhaustive dynamic call graph. Detector expansion is explicitly NOT a tranche-one success criterion.

evidenceKind.description: Kinds of evidence that may legitimately appear under directEvidence. New kinds require a contract version bump.

contextKind.description: Kinds of contextual signal that may appear under context. These must NEVER read like proof.

ownershipBasis.description: How ownership was attributed. Mirrors the existing expert boundary_basis vocabulary so feature-path retrieval and panel boundaries reason in the same terms.

downstreamEdgeType.description: Operational edge type vocabulary. Constrained to persisted OperationalEdgeType values; the bounded downstream retriever may intentionally omit inverse/context-only edge types from evidence packets.

crossLanguageStatus.description: Outcome of the cross-language promotion decision. refused-* values are explicit honest refusals (R6, R10) and MUST NOT be hidden when the question implied a frontend hop.

crossLanguageBasis.description: Basis of a backend-to-frontend association. naming-only is below promotion threshold by default; shared-config and shared-event are reserved vocabulary until artifact-backed detectors exist.

failureClass.description: Shared failure taxonomy. Validation reports and answer payloads use the same vocabulary so misses can be classified without translation.

structuralConfidenceClass.description: Confidence class carried over from StructuralEdge.confidence_class for any evidence sourced from the structural overlay.

id.description: Persisted node ID. For route surfaces this is the capability-surface ID (e.g. surface:http:POST:/offers).

label.description: Display label suitable for the primary-answer summary line.

candidates.description: Up to a small number of plausible targets. Populated for both ambiguous and unresolved statuses to make refusal honest and actionable.

summary.description: Single-sentence plain-language statement of the strongest evidence-backed retrieval claim. Example: 'POST /offers is handled by OfferController@store and belongs to Listings.'

rationale.description: Plain-language reason. Required when basis is 'overlay-led' or 'hybrid' so the basis is not opaque.

interactionKind.description: Dominant interactionKind extracted from contracts (e.g. api, page-rendered).

rationale.description: Why this single hop materially completes the answer. Required because the downstream slot is bounded to ONE step.

trustTier.description: Aggregate trust tier of the strongest promoted association. Absent for refused-* and not-applicable statuses.

associations.description: Concrete associations considered. For refused-* statuses, this MAY be populated to make refusal auditable; consumers MUST NOT render refused associations as feature paths.

rationale.description: Why the status was assigned. Required for refused-* so refusal is not silent.

mixedTrust.description: True iff target/evidence/ownership tiers contain more than one distinct value.
